title: Lagrangian Setup
description: Essential Criteria: The Lagrangian must be correctly formulated in terms of the generalized coordinates and velocities.

title: Normal Frequencies
description: Essential Criteria: The normal frequencies must be accurately derived and expressed in terms of the given parameters.

title: Normal Coordinates Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The motion of the system in normal coordinates must be correctly expressed with appropriate initial conditions.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The equations of motion for small oscillations must be correctly derived from the Lagrangian.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The application of initial conditions to find constants in the normal coordinates must be clearly shown.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the equations of motion or Lagrangian must be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistently applied throughout the derivation and final answers.

title: Neglecting Higher Order Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The justification for neglecting higher order terms in the small angle approximation should be provided.
